description:
Take that ride off-road with the Tread Freestyle Dirt Scooter. Built for riding on dirt and gravel, the Tread features a 21 x 5" alloy deck and steel handlebar for maximum durability. The triple anodized clamp collar and threaded headset offer precise, crisp steering, while the steel foot brake delivers controlled stopping power. Plus, large 200 mm air filled tires with ABEC-7 bearings provide a smooth, stable ride. Get dirty with the Tread scooter.
Freestyle scooter built for riding on dirt and gravel. Durable alloy deck supports riders ages 8 and up, with a 220 lbs. maximum weight limit.
Triple anodized clamp collar and threaded headset offer precise, crisp steering.
20-inch wide steel handlebar with 145 mm rubber grips provide durability and comfort.
Steel foot brake delivers controlled stopping power.
Large 200 mm air filled tires with ABEC-7 bearings provide a smooth, stable ride.

components.description: Steel foot brake delivers controlled stopping power
